import {resolveCode} from '../../../lib/stream';
export async function GET(req:Request){try{const code=new URL(req.url).searchParams.get('code')||'';const d=await resolveCode(code);return Response.json({title:d.title,expiresAt:d.expiresAt,src:'/api/media?code='+code},{headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});}catch(e){return Response.json({error:(e as Error).message},{status:400});}}

export async function GET(){try{const s=await selected();return Response.json({status:'ok',database:'ok',configured:!!s,version:'2026-10-10.1'},{headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}})}catch{return Response.json({status:'degraded',database:'unavailable'},{status:503,headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}})}}

import {getChatGPTUser} from '../app/chatgpt-auth';
export async function isTvOwner(){const u=await getChatGPTUser();if(!u)return false;const digest=await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',new TextEncoder().encode(u.email.toLowerCase()));return Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('')==='REPLACE_WITH_OWNER_EMAIL_SHA256';}
